jobs.name: ig1_board
jobs.meaning: дизайн-система серии вертикальных Reels бренда ИИАВАТАР (графит #111311, оранжевый #F3531B, светлый #F4F1EC): хук-заголовок, крупные субтитры с подсветкой слова, кадр «раскрытия» с глитчем, финальная карточка с призывом «Напишите ВЕДУЩИЙ», 4 разные раскладки 9:16
jobs.prompt: Create a complete design system board (brand style guide sheet) for a series of VERTICAL 9:16 Instagram Reels of the brand «ИИАВАТАР» (AI video presenters). Use the attached images ONLY as the brand reference: graphite #111311 background, vivid orange #F3531B accent, warm off-white #F4F1EC; bold modern grotesque headlines. Blocks: hero with title «ИИАВАТАР · Reels», colour palette with HEX codes, typography (bold condensed headline font + clean sans body), HOOK headline style (huge 2-3 word headline at the top, one word highlighted in orange), SUBTITLES style (large white bold words in the lower third, the current word highlighted with an orange marker box), the REVEAL frame (digital glitch effect, RGB split and scan lines over the presenter, short caption «Меня не существует»), END CARD (presenter small, big call to action «Напишите «ВЕДУЩИЙ» в директ», handle @iiavatar.video), and a block «РАСКЛАДКИ 9:16» with 4 phone-shaped frames showing 4 different layouts: (1) presenter full frame + hook headline, (2) presenter lower half + big number card above, (3) full-screen typography without presenter, (4) glitch reveal. Presenter on the board: a confident young Russian woman ~27 in a modern dark loft with orange accent light. All text in Russian, short, correctly spelled. Mood: bold, modern, premium-tech, energetic.

jobs.name: ig1_host_a
jobs.meaning: ведущая ~27, славянская внешность, тёмно-русое каре, графитовый оверсайз-пиджак поверх белой футболки, тонкая цепочка; лофт графит + оранжевая подсветка; по пояс, обе руки в кадре, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки, фотореализм, без надписей
jobs.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, of a real-looking person who could be a popular Russian Instagram creator — NOT a fashion model, NOT a stock photo, natural skin texture, believable. FRAMING (very important): waist-up, person in the centre, BOTH shoulders and BOTH arms fully inside the frame with generous margin (at least 12% of width) on left and right, hands relaxed at waist level holding nothing. Top of the head about 14% of frame height below the upper edge; face large and sharp. Expression: confident, lively eyes, face NEUTRAL as in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Setting: a modern dark loft studio, graphite walls #111311 slightly out of focus, a warm orange #F3531B accent light (neon strip or rim light) behind, soft key light on the face — cinematic but natural. Clothes harmonise with graphite and orange. No text, no logos, nothing covering the face, no headphones, no microphone. A young woman about 27, Slavic features, dark-blonde sleek bob haircut, natural make-up, a graphite oversized blazer over a plain white T-shirt, a thin silver chain.
